Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite atlas for a 2D fighting game. Input1 is SOLE character identity/costume/style reference. Keep exact face, hair, glasses, accessories, clothes, colors, toy proportions across all poses. Fixed orthographic three-quarter side camera, facing SCREEN RIGHT.
EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 24 separate complete full-body figures. Wide 1536x1024 canvas. Generous EMPTY transparent gutters: each figure about 160 pixels tall in its 256x256 cell, complete head and both shoes fully visible. Keep at least 25 transparent pixels between poses and at least 35 transparent pixels at all canvas edges, particularly bottom. Genuine transparent alpha, NO background, ground, shadows, glow, gradient, checkerboard, grid lines, captions, motion trails or energy effects. No extra people. Six columns precisely evenly spaced. One articulated body per cell, no touching neighboring figures.
Row1 POWER UPPERCUT six phases: 1 ready guard; 2 deep planted knee-bend, rear fist below waist winding up; 3 forceful rising fist at opponent chin height; 4 fully extended rising punch with torso twist and fist above own head; 5 visibly retract arm; 6 ready guard. Clearly stronger than jab/cross. Supporting foot stays grounded.
Row2 LAUNCHED VICTIM reaction, six phases: 1 struck on chin, head snaps backward; 2 body arches back and knees start tucking; 3 airborne backward arch, arms thrown outward and both knees tucked; 4 apex of flight, torso still arched and feet off ground; 5 descending, arms reach to brace, legs extend; 6 near landing, bent knees bracing while still recoiling. No attacker in sheet. Keep body scale identical; do NOT move figure vertically to depict height, the game applies actual physics elevation. Only change articulated body pose.
Row3 SPECIAL move: raise a small gold-rimmed handheld mirror in front of face, then thrust mirror forward, return guard. Six phases: guard, winding up/charging, contact/release, follow-through, retract/recover, guard.
Row4 ULTIMATE power: dramatically raise and swing a large gold-rimmed mirror overhead down and forward, present it outward, return guard. Six phases: guard, dramatic charge, powerful release, follow-through, retract/recover, guard.
Small held props may be shown; no detached flying props or large vehicles/portals in cells. Those effects are drawn by existing game system. Preserve exact outfit details. No new headwear, hairstyles or facial hair. Character ID: amper.
